name: HubSpot → DevRev migration POC
description: Parallel-run DevRev environment for a HubSpot customer. HubSpot is typically the CRM of record — Companies become DevRev accounts, Contacts become rev users, Deals/Opportunities are linked, and HubSpot support tickets migrate to DevRev. The AirSync snap-in keeps both systems in sync during the parallel-run period. Drop your HubSpot contact/company CSV exports into `csv` to import real data; the agent auto-detects HubSpot column headers.

works.title: HubSpot sync not reflecting deal stage updates in real time
works.body: Deals updated in HubSpot are not syncing to DevRev within the expected 5-minute window. Seeing delays of up to 2 hours.

works.title: Bulk contact import duplicating rev users across orgs
works.body: When importing 2000+ contacts via CSV, the importer creates duplicate rev user records if the same email appears in two company exports.

works.title: Workflow automation not triggering on deal closed-won from HubSpot
works.body: We set up a workflow to auto-create an onboarding task when a HubSpot deal moves to Closed Won, but the trigger is not firing.

works.title: Revenue reporting dashboard shows incorrect MRR after HubSpot sync
works.body: Monthly Recurring Revenue figures in the DevRev reporting dashboard do not match HubSpot after the AirSync completed. Totals are off by ~12%.

works.title: Setup wizard crashes on Step 3 when HubSpot OAuth token expires
works.body: During onboarding, if the HubSpot OAuth token expires mid-setup, the wizard throws an unhandled error instead of prompting re-auth.

works.title: Invoice not generated after plan upgrade via HubSpot deal link
works.body: Customer upgraded from Starter to Growth plan via the HubSpot deal flow. Invoice was not auto-generated in the billing module.

ui_guidance.title: Map HubSpot object types to DevRev
steps: HubSpot Company → DevRev Account (name, domain, owner mapped automatically via AirSync)
HubSpot Contact → DevRev Rev User (email is the dedup key; org association via Company link)
HubSpot Deal → DevRev Opportunity (deal stage, amount, and close date are preserved)
HubSpot Ticket → DevRev Ticket (priority, status, and owner mapped; add 'migrated-from-hubspot' tag for traceability)
HubSpot Note/Activity → DevRev Timeline Entry (attached to the relevant ticket or account)
HubSpot Product → DevRev Part (only for software companies; map using the parts hierarchy above)

ui_guidance.title: Map HubSpot priorities and lifecycle stages to DevRev SLA tiers
steps: HubSpot ticket priority 'Urgent' → DevRev p0 (blocker), apply Enterprise SLA
HubSpot 'High' → p1, apply Enterprise or Growth SLA based on account tier
HubSpot 'Medium' → p2, apply Growth or Starter SLA
HubSpot 'Low' → p3, apply Starter SLA
Map HubSpot Lifecycle Stage to SLA policy: 'Customer' → Enterprise SLA; 'Lead/Subscriber' → Starter SLA
After applying, go to Settings → SLA Policies to create these three policies and assign them to the seeded accounts.

ui_guidance.title: Connecting HubSpot AirSync
steps: Settings → Integrations → Snap-ins → search for 'HubSpot' → Install.
Authenticate using a HubSpot admin account (OAuth 2.0 — no API key needed).
Select which HubSpot pipeline(s) to sync: Contacts, Companies, Deals, and Tickets.
Map HubSpot owners to DevRev dev users — HubSpot owner emails must match DevRev user emails for auto-assignment.
Run an initial one-way sync (HubSpot → DevRev) to populate historical data before enabling bidirectional sync.
Enable periodic sync — recommend every 15 minutes during active migration, every hour post-cutover.
Note: HubSpot Deals sync as Opportunities. To view them in DevRev, go to Issues and switch the type filter to 'Opportunity'.

ui_guidance.title: Importing your real HubSpot export
steps: Export contacts: HubSpot → Contacts → Actions → Export → select 'All properties' → CSV.
Export companies: HubSpot → Companies → Actions → Export.
Drop CSVs next to this blueprint and add csv entries with entity 'contacts' and 'accounts'.
The agent auto-detects HubSpot headers (First Name, Last Name, Email, Company Name, Lifecycle Stage, HubSpot Owner) and applies the column map automatically.
For ticket exports: HubSpot → Service → Tickets → Actions → Export. Use entity 'tickets' in the csv entry.
Override mappings via column_map if your HubSpot instance uses custom properties.

ui_guidance.title: Replicating HubSpot workflow automation in DevRev
steps: Map HubSpot Workflows to DevRev Automation rules (Settings → Automation).
Common trigger: HubSpot deal moves to 'Closed Won' → DevRev: create onboarding ticket, assign to Onboarding & Success group.
Common trigger: HubSpot deal amount > $50K → DevRev: tag ticket 'enterprise', assign to Enterprise Support group.
Common trigger: HubSpot contact 'Lifecycle Stage' changes to 'Customer' → DevRev: update rev user record, apply Enterprise SLA.
Use DevRev snap-ins to build custom triggers driven by HubSpot webhook events.
Replicate HubSpot email sequences using DevRev's email channel + workflow automation for follow-up reminders.

ui_guidance.title: Deploying PLuG to replace HubSpot live chat
steps: Settings → Support → PLuG Settings → Enable PLuG widget → copy the Unique App ID.
Remove the HubSpot chat widget script from your product or website.
Add the PLuG script: <script src='https://plug-platform.devrev.ai/static/plug.js'></script>.
Initialize with your App ID and configure the AI agent grounded on your KB articles.
Configure routing: unauthenticated users → AI deflection first; authenticated users → route to Technical Support group.
For Enterprise accounts: configure escalation to the Enterprise Support group.
Test the AI-to-human handoff before going live.

ui_guidance.title: Parallel-run cutover checklist
steps: Week 1–2: HubSpot is system of record; DevRev in read-only parallel mode. Validate all contacts/companies/deals imported correctly.
Week 3–4: Enable bidirectional AirSync. New tickets created in either system. Verify sync latency is acceptable (<15 min).
Cutover day: Disable HubSpot ticket creation. Redirect support email to DevRev. Update PLuG widget to point at DevRev.
Post-cutover: Keep HubSpot AirSync running for Deals/Opportunities only (CRM data). Disable ticket sync.
30 days post-cutover: Archive HubSpot support tickets. DevRev is now the single source of truth for support.
